visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black long-sleeved button-down shirt, is positioned in the center of the frame against a light blue to white gradient background. A large stylized dark graphic, resembling a penguin's head with wide white eyes, is visible behind him. He holds a blue pen and a black remote, using frequent hand gestures and changing facial expressions to communicate while looking directly at the camera lens. (2) The scene cuts to a static photograph of a black cow standing in a grassy field. The cow has been painted with distinct white zebra-like stripes across its torso and legs. White dashed circles and text labels 'Body', 'Leg', and 'Biting flies' are superimposed on the image to highlight specific areas of the cow's anatomy. (3) The video returns to the man in the studio setting. He continues his animated delivery, pointing with his pen and gesturing with his palms open. Large text overlays in bold Chinese characters appear at the bottom and top of the frame, changing frequently to emphasize his speech. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. (4) A split-screen graphic appears showing three different cows labeled 'a', 'b', and 'c' standing in an outdoor grassy area. Cow 'a' has zebra stripes, cow 'b' has black stripes on its black hide, and cow 'c' is a plain black cow. The background is a natural green outdoor landscape with trees and fences. (5) The man returns to the screen, continuing his presentation with high energy. He occasionally adjusts his glasses or points the remote toward the camera. Various variety-style captions and brand logos appear throughout the duration, maintaining a consistent graphic style with the previous studio segments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Mandarin at a brisk pace. The delivery is clear and professionally articulated, set against an upbeat electronic pop background track. The music has a prominent synth-bass and rhythmic drums that provide a constant driving force. (2) A distinctive digital 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The speaker's tone shifts to a slightly more inquisitive pitch as he poses a scientific question. The BGM maintains its tempo but drops slightly in volume to prioritize the vocal clarity. (3) A 'pop' sound effect occurs as new text graphics are visually introduced. The speaker uses a more narrative and humorous tone when describing the 'Ig Nobel Prize.' There is a brief clapping sound effect added in post-production to match the 'applause' mention in the speech. (4) The audio continues with high vocal arousal as the speaker explains the experimental methodology involving the cows. The music becomes more textural with lighter synth pads but keeps the steady beat. Small UI clicks and digital chimes are heard periodically, punctuating key points in the scientific explanation. (5) As the speaker discusses the results, his voice exhibits a triumphant and confident tone. The music swells slightly in brightness, highlighting the positive outcome of the study. The recording is studio-clean with no audible environmental noise, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout the duration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to explain a quirky scientific study that won the Ig Nobel Prize, specifically researching how painting zebra-like stripes on black cows can significantly reduce the annoyance of biting flies. It uses a high-energy, humorous presentation style to make scientific knowledge accessible and engaging for a social media audience.
